text:
maria: Heads-up: CI started showing a bunch of SAST results with "owner: unknown" after last infra roll. I think decrypts failed for archived artifacts. anyone seeing this?

oliver: I saw failures too. Build logs show KMS 403 on decrypt from serviceAccount=scanner-runner@redwood-inference. Could be an RBAC/group drift.

scanner-bot: job sast-10712 -> ERROR PermissionDenied: projects/rdw-prod/.../cryptoKeys/sast-key: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com

jake: I merged a group consolidation PR yesterday (PR#3890). That changed nested group memberships. Maybe scanner-runner lost effective membership.

maria: CI error snippet:
```
ERROR: 403 PermissionDenied
Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' denied for serviceAccount:scanner-runner@...
```

toni: This is an incident risk (missed vulns). @sec-oncall please open an incident channel and advise mitigations. :rotating_light:

sec-oncall: Opening #inc-330111-keystore-decrypt. Immediate mitigation: apply temporary roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to scanner-runner and re-run failing jobs + backfill. Also capturing audit logs.

oliver: Quick gcloud if useful:
```bash
PROJECT=rdw-prod
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding sast-key \
  --location=global --keyring=keystore \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-runner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --project=$PROJECT
```

infra-logs: Found audit entry ts=3301112300 by devops-bot@redwood-inference removing group membership that resolved to scanner-runner. Log link: projects/rdw-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/entries/ghi789. Retention 30d.

sec-oncall: Root cause: automated group reorg removed SA indirectly. Action items: emergency RBAC restore (done), backfill and triage new findings (maria/jake), add presubmit/integration test asserting scanner-runner can decrypt (jake), extend audit retention for keystore admin events to 90d and add alert for KMS IAM changes (infra/security), update SDLC runbook to require KMS access check for infra group PRs (toni).

maria: Starting backfill and will post results in incident channel. I'll open RFC for runbook and attach presubmit PR.

jake: Also marking findings surfaced during the gap as "potentially-delayed"; owners must re-validate severity.

toni: Quick postmortem after backfill closes. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
